message.content:
Wooden bookends are not "articles of wood" under 4421 in a general sense, but they could fit under 4420 (wood marquetry, statuettes and other ornaments of wood) or under 4421. The key question is whether bookends are ornaments. CBP rulings on wooden bookends have generally classified them in 4421.99 as other articles of wood. Bookends are functional, used to hold books upright, so they are not mere ornaments. The 4421.99 subheadings are:

- 4421.99.97 (other)
- 4421.99.98 (other, other)

The current 4421.99 structure is 4421.99.10 (wood toothpicks and similar), 4421.99.20 (wood articles for lace/embroidery), 4421.99.30 (wooden pegs), 4421.99.40 (clothes hangers)… and 4421.99.97 (other). As I recall, the last tariff structure is 4421.99.9780, though the statistical suffix may vary. The 10-digit code I recall for "other" is 4421.99.9780, with 4421.99.9880 as a later variant.

I'll go with 4421.99.9880.
